items.venue: Taipei National University of the Arts Performing Arts Centre Theatre
items.notes:

1997/03/21-23

Music:
Qu Xiaosong
Pun Tak Shu
Yu Yat Yiu

Musician:
Sumire Yashihara

Costume:
Vivienne Tam

Synopsis：
To Director Danny Yung, the multi-media performance is an exploration and articulation of the artists’ experience, a summary of his relationship with his environment, and with the form and contents of his art.

Similar to The Book of Mountain and Ocean that written five thousand years ago, the performance has a very loose narrative, but instead structured through a chain of images of installations evolving, entwining and integrating into each other.
